# `/api/v1` reference

> Every endpoint the phone app speaks — method, path, what it does and what it answers — read from the FastAPI app in `ocrmd/web/v1.py`, so it cannot drift from the code.

The machine-readable contract is [openapi-v1.json](openapi-v1.json); the app's TypeScript types are generated from it (`cd mobile && npm run gen:api`). How pairing and access work: [docs/mobile.md](../mobile.md). Every route needs `Authorization: Bearer <device token>` from another machine when the server runs with `ocrmd serve --lan`, except `GET /api/v1/ping` and `POST /api/v1/pair`; the `devices` routes answer only the computer ocrmd runs on.

| Method | Path | What it does | Body | Answers |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/v1/ping` | Open to anyone who can reach the port: says only that this is ocrmd and whether to pair. | — | `Ping` |
| POST | `/api/v1/pair` | Exchange a pairing code made on the computer (`ocrmd pair`) for this device's token. | `PairIn` | `PairOut` |
| GET | `/api/v1/me` | The device this request's token belongs to. | — | `Device` |
| GET | `/api/v1/server` | What this server can do: API version, access mode, whether pages get the model's reading now, OCR engines. | — | `ServerInfo` |
| GET | `/api/v1/devices` | Paired devices and pending codes. | — | `list[Device]` |
| POST | `/api/v1/devices/pairings` | A one-time code for a phone, with the link and QR code that carry it. | `PairingIn` | `Pairing` |
| DELETE | `/api/v1/devices/{device_id}` | Revoke a device (or cancel a pending code) by id or name. | — | `Device` |
| GET | `/api/v1/documents` | Every document in the library, with its catalogue entry and progress. | — | `list[Document]` |
| POST | `/api/v1/documents` | Start a new document before its first capture, so it has a title from the first page on. | `NewDocument` | `Document` |
| GET | `/api/v1/documents/{slug}` | One document with a row (and a thumbnail) per page. | — | `DocumentDetail` |
| GET | `/api/v1/search` | Full-text search over every page of every document (or of `doc`). | — | `list[Hit]` |
| GET | `/api/v1/documents/{slug}/pages/{seq}` | A page: its reconciled text, open disagreements, verdict, images and neighbours. | — | `Page` |
| PUT | `/api/v1/documents/{slug}/pages/{seq}` | A human edit: it survives the next `verify`. | `PageEditIn` | `Page` |
| GET | `/api/v1/documents/{slug}/pages/{seq}/image/{kind}` | A picture of the page: `flat`, `processed`, `bin` or `raw`; `?max=` scales it down to a JPEG. | — | `image/png` \| `image/jpeg` |
| POST | `/api/v1/documents/{slug}/pages/{seq}/resolve` | Settle one disagreement with the OCR reading, the model's, or your own text. | `ResolveIn` | `Page` |
| POST | `/api/v1/documents/{slug}/pages/{seq}/signoff` | Mark the page reviewed; refused (409) while a disagreement is open. | `SignOffIn` | `Page` |
| POST | `/api/v1/documents/{slug}/pages/{seq}/reopen` | Undo a sign-off. | — | `Page` |
| POST | `/api/v1/documents/{slug}/captures` | One photo from the phone's camera → a page (or two, for a spread), read twice like any other. | `multipart/form-data` | `Job` |
| POST | `/api/v1/documents/{slug}/verify` | Run the stages a document's pages are missing (the model pass for pages captured OCR-only). | `VerifyIn` | `Job` |
| GET | `/api/v1/jobs` | Recent jobs, newest first; `active` keeps the queued and running ones. | — | `list[Job]` |
| GET | `/api/v1/jobs/{job_id}` | A job's progress and, for a capture, what became of the photo (`results`). | — | `Job` |

## Models

- **CaptureResult** — What became of one uploaded photo. `file`, `client_id`, `pages`, `duplicate_of`, `rejected`, `error`
- **CapturedPage** — `sequence`, `status`
- **Device** — `id`, `name`, `platform`, `created_at`, `paired_at`, `last_seen_at`, `revoked_at`, `pending`
- **Document** — `slug`, `title`, `author`, `year`, `kind`, `tags`, `project`, `pages`, `counts`, `done`, `flagged`, `unverified`, `needs_reshoot`, `page_labels`, `created_at`, `last_captured_at`, `scanning`, `cover`
- **DocumentDetail** — `slug`, `title`, `author`, `year`, `kind`, `tags`, `project`, `pages`, `counts`, `done`, `flagged`, `unverified`, `needs_reshoot`, `page_labels`, `created_at`, `last_captured_at`, `scanning`, `cover`, `page_list`
- **Flag** — One open disagreement: `ocr` and `llm` are the two readings, `context` the text around the mark. `n`, `ocr`, `llm`, `context`
- **Hit** — `document`, `sequence`, `page_id`, `page_label`, `status`, `snippet`, `title`
- **Job** — `id`, `kind`, `doc`, `status`, `created_at`, `started_at`, `ended_at`, `error`, `done`, `total`, `results`, `log`
- **LogLine** — `at`, `level`, `line`
- **NewDocument** — `slug`, `title`?, `author`?, `kind`?, `tags`?, `project`?
- **Page** — `slug`, `sequence`, `id`, `status`, `page_label`, `part`, `width_px`, `advice`, `reviewed_by`, `llm_error`, `captured_at`, `agreement`, `overlap`, `body`, `flags`, `unresolved`, `images`, `context`, `frontmatter`, `prev`, `next`, `prev_flagged`, `next_flagged`, `exists`
- **PageEditIn** — `body`?, `page_label`?, `context`?
- **PageRef** — `document`, `sequence`
- **PageRow** — `sequence`, `id`, `status`, `page_label`, `part`, `agreement`, `overlap`, `captured_at`, `reviewed_by`, `llm_error`, `thumb`
- **PairIn** — `code`, `name`, `platform`?
- **PairOut** — `token`, `device`, `server`
- **Pairing** — `id`, `code`, `expires_at`, `server`, `link`, `qr_svg`
- **PairingIn** — `name`?
- **Ping** — Is this an ocrmd server, which API does it speak, and does this request need (or carry) a token. `ocrmd`, `api`, `version`, `access`, `local`, `paired`
- **ResolveIn** — `n`, `chosen`
- **ServerInfo** — `version`, `api`, `access`, `llm`, `provider`, `model`, `ocr_engines`, `scanning`, `sinks`, `formats`
- **SignOffIn** — `who`?
- **VerifyIn** — `refresh`?, `flagged_only`?, `no_llm`?
